page.layout: One column of running text. Marginal notes in the left margin: "Via Lactea" beside the Milky Way paragraph and a Greek note "ἀστρο-λογία" beside the astronomy paragraph. Page number and running head at top.

p.i: Sunt Aries, Taurus, Gemini, Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra[?], Scorpius, Arcitenens, Caper, Amphora, Pisces.

main_text.p: Extra Zodiacum sidera vel sunt Bore-alia, vel Australia.
Borealia sunt versus Aquilonem conspicua Septentrionalibus populis: sunt-que 21.
Australia sunt ultra Æquinoctialem versus Meridiem, Meridionalibus populis conspicuae: suntq; 15. De quibus singulis in Astrologia.
His fixis stellis à quibusdam annumeratur Via Lactea. Circulus Lacteus, qui putatur esse extensa compactura multarum minutissimarum stellarum, ob parvitatem visum effugientium.
Hactenus stellarum doctrina breviter comprehensa est. Sunt autem hae conditae, in tempora, dies, & annos: Ergo ἀστρο-λογία motus astrorum dimetitur tempora, quorum doctrina dicitur ἀστρονομία[?].

p.i: Astrorum motus non tempus, id est, durationem efficit, sed temporum dimensiones & distinctiones. Tempus distinctū, qua distinctum,

page.notes: Greek word in main text (ἀστρονομία) and the Greek marginal note (ἀστρο-λογία) are uncertain at the letter level; the print is small. "Libraq," in the zodiac list may be a printing error for "Libra," and is marked. "21" and "15" are read from small numerals. The faint word "Sunt" at the lower left is show-through from the reverse and is omitted. Whether the first paragraph continues from the previous page is inferred from the sentence, not from an indent.
